Overview is back to CB1 CLOSED, PV RUNNING, model VALID, bus ENERGIZED and telemetry HEALTHY. Grid 8056 kW, PV 2000 kW, bus 13.61 kV, T1 42.1%, served load 10000 kW.

CommandHistory shows operator1 APPLIED for sequences 8 OPEN CB1, 9 RESET TRIPS, 10 CLOSE CB1 and 11 START PV1. Matching REQUESTED/APPLIED pairs are fully visible for 9, 10 and 11; the sequence 8 REQUESTED row is partly below the screenshot crop.

Overview reads DATA UNAVAILABLE. All conductors are amber; CB1 has a question mark and UNKNOWN text; PV, model and bus are UNKNOWN. All four KPIs and served-load text are unavailable. Telemetry reads CHECK ALARMS - data unavailable or invalid.
